verdict.rationale: Weave documents a Service API reference with REST endpoints, and a probe confirms a machine-readable OpenAPI spec at docs.wandb.ai/openapi.json. That establishes a structured API reference, but nothing in the pack shows it is interactive (e.g., try-it-now requests) or that it includes runnable examples. The Playground is for prompt and model iteration, not an API explorer, so it is not credited here. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive in-browser API explorer, runnable or copy-and-execute code examples within the reference, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
